nodes.question: What are some emerging and practical food innovations that can help achieve the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) target?
nodes.answer: Some emerging and practical food innovations that can help achieve the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) target include plant-based meat alternatives, sustainable packaging solutions, precision agriculture technologies, and food waste reduction strategies.

nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What are the benefits of using antimicrobial nanocomposites in food preservation?
nodes.answer: Antimicrobial nanocomposites offer extended preservation during transportation and considerably prolong the shelf life of perishable food products, contributing to improved food safety and reduced food waste.
